sources.title: Invariant Information Clustering for Unsupervised Image Classification and Segmentation
sources.access: Official code README and primary-paper abstract; CVF full PDF returned403.
sources.finding: Auxiliary overclustering is a documented component; this experiment tests only coarse/fine prototype geometry, not the full objective or auxiliary head.

sources.title: SPICE: Semantic Pseudo-labeling for Image Clustering
sources.access: Primary full-text HTML, sectionsIII-B/III-C and IV-E/IV-F.
sources.finding: Feature model and clustering head are jointly trained after reliable pseudo-label selection. Frozen-head refinement alone does not implement this stage; reliable pseudo-label quality remains critical.

sources.title: Material Recognition in the Wild with the Materials in Context Database
sources.access: Primary-paper abstract/search text; no full-paper replication.
sources.finding: Material recognition uses patch appearance as well as context. Global/local descriptors are a hypothesis; external MINC images or material-trained weights are not downloaded.

sources.title: DINOv2 official code and models
sources.access: Official README and existing pinned local image-only checkpoint.
sources.finding: Global and patch features are distinct representations. The cached CLS vector is checked against re-extraction; patch moments are an original pooling adaptation.
